nodes.name: Loop Over Test Cases
nodes.notes: Processes ONE test case at a time - not true parallel execution. This is intentional: your Playwright server runs one browser session per call, and sequential processing means if test #23 breaks, you know exactly which one, without 58 browser windows fighting for resources.

Consider storing this in n8n's Variables (Settings > Variables) as PLAYWRIGHT_TUNNEL_URL and referencing {{ $vars.PLAYWRIGHT_TUNNEL_URL }} here instead - one place to update instead of hunting through nodes each time.
